name: AVK App Platform
description: Deployment platform for avkaiexplorer.com: security-gated pipeline, local stg, tunnelled prod.
progress: Phases 0-6 accepted (Phase 6: legal pack, contact form, accessibility gate, docker-watch; owner tasks open: postal address, attorney review). Next: Phase 7 Alerts

setup.hint: the avk CLI source must be present

notes: Needs AVK_HOME (C:\avk) with its venv; see README. Launch starts the stg stack (pg-stg, Mailpit, index on 4800) and the apps on their stg ports; prod is started at logon and by avk prod up.
